g.title: The authors make three main contributions
g.desc: authors make three main contributions — framework overview of data-efficient LVM via augmentation and distillation
g.text: Figure 1 · Autoregressive LVM encodes images to a 1D sequence, made data-efficient via augmentation + distillation.

g.title: First: simple augmentation (random crop and flip) rebalances long-tailed data as well as new samples
g.desc: first they show simple augmentation random crop flip rebalances long-tailed multi-task data as effectively as collecting more real samples

g.title: Second: they bring knowledge distillation to autoregressive LVMs for the first time
g.desc: second they bring knowledge distillation autoregressive large vision models first time LLaMA one-billion teacher lift compact three-hundred-million student single multi-task

g.title: Third: a practical 80M model reaching 83% ImageNet top-1 by combining both techniques
